definitions.gloss: end of work; end of the business day; closing
definitions.explanation: The conclusion of work or business hours for the day. Used in both workplace and school contexts. The opposite of 始業 (start of work).

examples.japanese: {終業|しゅうぎょう}{時間|じかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧{五時|ごじ}です。
examples.english: The end of the workday is at 5 PM.

examples.japanese: {終業|しゅうぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}ったら→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支度|したく}→支度：02083_shitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the closing bell rings, I start getting ready to go home.

examples.japanese: {終業|しゅうぎょう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I ended up going to dinner with a colleague after work.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({終業|しゅうぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). In schools, {終業|しゅうぎょう}{式|しき} (closing ceremony) marks the end of a school term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}{時間|じかん} (closing time; end of work hours)
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after work)
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}{式|しき} (closing ceremony — at school)
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャイム→チャイム：00024_chaimu⟧ (the end-of-work chime)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{始業|しぎょう}→始業：25327_shigyou⟧: start of work — the opposite; the beginning of work or class hours
- ⟦{退勤|たいきん}→退勤：04550_taikin⟧: leaving work — the act of physically departing the workplace
